categories.main_business_segments: Nexen Tire Corporation primarily operates in the tire manufacturing, sales, and rental sector, accounting for 99.72% of sales. It also has non-tire business segments including logistics and warehousing (Nuri Networks), tire mold manufacturing and repair (Qingdao Nexen Machine Corporation), and bakery operations (Angel Withers). The company is a global tire enterprise with a focus on passenger car and SUV tires.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company uses advanced automated manufacturing facilities in domestic and overseas plants, including South Korea, China, and the Czech Republic. It employs strict quality standards such as IATF 16949 and integrates AI and big data technologies in product development for new tread patterns, materials, and optimization. Nexen Tire emphasizes eco-friendly product development using recycled and renewable materials and focuses on performance enhancements like wear resistance, noise reduction, and fuel efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nexen Tire serves automotive manufacturers (OE market) and replacement tire markets (RE market) globally, with key customers including premium car makers like Porsche, Volkswagen, and Audi. Its products are sold in approximately 120 countries, targeting both new vehicle production and aftermarket tire replacement. The company also serves logistics clients domestically through its non-tire business segments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in South Korea, China (Qingdao), and Europe (Czech Republic). It has sales subsidiaries and offices across North America, Europe, Asia, and Oceania, including the US, Canada, Germany, Italy, Russia, Japan, Malaysia, Turkey, Australia, and Egypt. The global sales network covers major markets in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nexen Tire operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain, focusing on tire manufacturing and sales. It sources raw materials such as natural rubber and synthetic rubber from upstream suppliers and delivers finished tires downstream to automotive OEMs and replacement markets. The company also engages in downstream activities like tire rental and logistics services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to enhance tire performance in fuel efficiency, grip, durability, noise reduction, and eco-friendliness, with a focus on electric vehicle tires and compliance with tightening environmental regulations. It maintains a global R&D network with centers in South Korea, the US, China, and Germany. Nexen Tire integrates AI and big data into product development and invests in sustainable materials and technologies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and particulate matter.
categories.revenue_model: Nexen Tire generates revenue primarily through product sales of tires to OEMs and replacement markets. It also earns income from tire rental services, logistics and warehousing services, and tire mold manufacturing. Sales are conducted via direct sales, distributors, and global sales subsidiaries, with payment methods including cash, electronic payments, and letters of credit for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the domestic Korean market, Nexen Tire competes mainly with Hankook Tire and Kumho Tire, collectively dominating over 90% of the market. Globally, it competes with major tire manufacturers from the US, Japan, and Europe. Nexen positions itself as a global tire company with expanding production capacity and premium OEM supply relationships, enhancing brand recognition through motorsports and environmental certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Nexen Tire reported consolidated sales of approximately 2.7 trillion KRW and operating profit of 187 billion KRW, marking a return to profitability after prior losses. Total assets stood at about 4.23 trillion KRW with equity of 1.7 trillion KRW. The company has shown steady revenue growth and improved financial stability with a current ratio of 117% and a debt ratio of 148%. It maintains a stable credit rating of A from major Korean credit agencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nexen Tire emphasizes high-quality, safe, and technologically advanced tires tailored to diverse global market needs, including premium OEM supply. Its competitive differentiation lies in integrating cutting-edge R&D, eco-friendly materials, and AI-driven product development to deliver superior performance in fuel efficiency, noise reduction, and durability. The company also pioneers tire rental services in Korea, offering flexible and convenient solutions to consumers.
